# Kenney Animated Characters Retro

- Model: `characterMedium.fbx`
- Appearance: `humanMaleA.png` skin (short brown hair, casual T-shirt, long trousers and shoes)
- Official source: https://kenney.nl/assets/animated-characters-retro
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal; original license text is included in `License.txt`.
- Pack preview: `Preview.png`

The model replaces the previous superhero body. The project's existing Quaternius Universal Animation Library remains the source for locomotion and crouch clips; Unity imports the new model as Humanoid for retargeting and Humanoid IK.
